headline: The item's mechanism is dead in BOTH of its formulations, and the measurement that killed it also found the real root cause. As the factory can actually implement it (--exposure-cap is enforced per hydrate run = per edition), capping the five named relations at 60/fact is EXACTLY INERT: cov delta +0.0000, because the max per-(edition,fact) count for those relations is 24 and 0.0000% exceed 60. As the gate would aggregate it (cross-edition), the same cap is WRONG-SIGNED: raw cov 2.7786 -> 2.9976, effective 2.3244 -> 2.7070, and it drives dominance 0.8491 -> 0.9092 across dominance_max_frac 0.85, flipping a currently-PASSING gate to FAIL. The '1,368 surfaces/fact amplification' the item is built on is not generator over-emission at all: it is CROSS-EDITION FACT-KEY COLLISION.

A generator cap of 60 therefore still presents up to 60 x 87 = 5220 to the gate. Generator and gate do not agree on what a 'fact' is.
